---
title: "Figures"
format: html
editor: visual
---


```{r Getting things ready, include=FALSE}

library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)
library(tidyverse)

# If not loaded already:
nesting <- read_csv('data/Nesting_cleaned_all_bees.csv')
nesting_os <- read_csv('data/Nesting_cleaned_osmia.csv')
nesting_meg <- read_csv('data/Nesting_cleaned_megachile.csv')




theme_set(theme_classic(base_size=12)) 

```


```{r Nest per Available Cavities, echo=FALSE, out.width='50%', out.height='50%', fig.show='hold', fig.align='side', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

nesting_os %>% filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>% 
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 164 osmia nests for osmia through the summer
nesting_meg %>% filter(!is.na(Bee_choice)) %>% 
  summarize(nests_total = sum(Bee_choice)) # 58 osmia nests for osmia through the summer


### Osmia 

nesting_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Available_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.5, aes(colour = Occupant)) +
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'grey75') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('steelblue3', 'plum3')) +
  labs(x='Available cavities', y = 'Presence of Presence of new nest for each visit', title = 'Osmia: available cavities (Osmia season)') +
  theme( # removing the y axes labels
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) + 
  xlim(0, 18)


### Megachile 

nesting_meg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Available_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.5, aes(colour = Occupant)) +
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'grey75') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkgoldenrod2', 'steelblue3')) +
  labs(x='Available cavities', y = 'Presence of Presence of new nest for each visit', title = 'Osmia: available cavities (Osmia season)') +
  theme( # removing the y axes labels
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) + 
  xlim(0, 18)


```


```{r Nests per Conspecific Presence, echo=FALSE, out.width='50%', out.height='50%', fig.show='hold', fig.align='side', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


# Osmia # with pseudo 
nesting_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_ps_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = Occupant)) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'grey75') +
  labs(title = 'Osmia occupancies', x = 'Osmia occupancies (including pseudo)', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('steelblue3', 'plum3'))  +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  xlim(0, 18)




# Osmia # without pseudo 
nesting_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_no_ps_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = Occupant)) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'grey75') +
  labs(title = 'Osmia occupancies', x = 'Osmia occupancies (excluding pseudo)', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('steelblue3', 'plum3')) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  xlim(0, 18)




### Megachile with pseudo 

nesting_meg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Meg_ps_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = Occupant)) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'pink3', fill = 'lightpink') +
  labs(title = 'Megachile occupancies',  x = 'Megachile occupancies (including pseudo)', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkgoldenrod2', 'steelblue3')) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  xlim(0, 18)


### Megachile without pseudo 

nesting_meg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Meg_no_ps_prior, Bee_choice)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6, aes(colour = Occupant)) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'grey75') +
  labs(title = 'Megachile occupancies',  x = 'Megachile occupancies (excluding pseudo)', y = 'Presence of new nest for each visit') +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('darkgoldenrod2', 'steelblue3')) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
  xlim(0, 18)



```


```{r Parasitism}


# each data point is again a trapnest and date combo


# New nests against parasites in the trapnest

nesting_os %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Par_in_trapnest, Bee_choice)) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', colour = 'rosybrown2', fill = 'rosybrown2') +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.03, alpha = 0.4) 


# Cumulative number of parasites per osmia occupancies

nesting_os %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Cumulative_par)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_no_ps_prior, Cumulative_par)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', colour = 'coral2', fill = 'coral2') +
  labs(x = 'Osmia occupancies (excluding pseudo)', y = 'Cumulative number of parasites') 

nesting_os %>% # with peusdo 
  filter(!is.na(Cumulative_par)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_ps_prior, Cumulative_par)) + 
  geom_jitter(height = 0.05, alpha = 0.6) + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', colour = 'coral2', fill = 'coral2') +
  labs(x = 'Osmia occupancies (including pseudo)', y = 'Cumulative number of parasites') 


# Proportion of cells in a nest with parasites per osmia occupancies

nesting %>% 
  filter(Occupant == 'osmia' & !is.na(Prop_cells_par)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_no_ps_prior, Prop_cells_par)) +
  geom_jitter() + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'plum', fill = 'plum') +
  labs(x = 'Osmia occupancies (excluding pseudo)', y = 'Proportion of cells in a nest that are parasitized') 

nesting %>% # with peusdo 
  filter(Occupant == 'osmia' & !is.na(Prop_cells_par)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Osmia_ps_prior, Prop_cells_par)) +
  geom_jitter() + 
  stat_smooth(method='glm', method.args=list(family='binomial'), colour = 'plum', fill = 'plum') +
  labs(x = 'Osmia occupancies (including pseudo)', y = 'Proportion of cells in a nest that are parasitized')


```



```{r Nest Investment, echo=FALSE, out.width='50%', out.height='50%', fig.show='hold', fig.align='side', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}



## Plot number of cells with filled length
investment %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Prop_filled, Number_of_cells, label = Nest_ID)) + 
  geom_jitter() + geom_text(aes(colour = Trapnest), size = 2)


investment$Treatment <- factor(investment$Treatment, levels=c('Low', 'Mid', 'High'))


investment %>% filter(Occupant == 'osmia' | Occupant == 'megachile') %>% 
  ggplot(aes(Treatment, Prop_filled, fill = Occupant)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c('goldenrod2', 'plum3'), labels = c('Megachile', 'Osmia')) +
  labs(y = 'Proportion of straw filled with cells') + 
  theme(legend.text = element_text(face = 'italic'))



```
